segments.contextAfter: Retain and release operations for `SWIFT_SHARED_REFERENCE` types can now be methods of the type. You can now annotate a C/C++ type with `SWIFT_SHARED_REFERENCE(.doRetain, .doRelease)` to use methods `doRetain` and `doRelease` as the lifetime operations for the type.  (160696723)
